an6.42:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena Icchānaṅgalaṃ nāma Kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tad avasari.
an6.42:1.3: Tatra sudaṃ Bhagavā Icchānaṅgale viharati Icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
an6.42:1.5: ‘samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Sakyaputto Sakyakulā pabbajito Icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto Icchānaṅgale viharati Icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
an6.42:1.6: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
an6.42:1.7: iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno . . .pe . . . buddho Bhagavā ti.
an6.42:1.8: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ . . .pe . . . arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī' ti.
an6.42:1.9: Atha kho Icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tassā rattiyā accayena pahūtaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ ādāya yena Icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍo ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhaṃsu uccāsaddā mahāsaddā. 2.
an6.42:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Nāgito Bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
an6.42:2.2: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Nāgitaṃ āmantesi
an6.42:2.3: ‘ke pana te Nāgita uccāsaddā mahāsaddā, kevaṭṭā maññe macche vilopentī' ti?
an6.42:2.4: ‘Ete bhante Icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā pahūtaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ ādāya bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā Bhagavantaṃ yeva uddissa bhikkhusaṅghañ cā' ti.
an6.42:2.5: ‘Māhaṃ Nāgita yasena samāgamaṃ mā ca mayā yaso.
an6.42:2.6: Yo kho Nāgita na-yimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an6.42:2.7: so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyā' ti
an6.42:3.3: Yena yen'eva dāni bhante Bhagavā gamissati, tanninnā 'va bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā c'eva jānapadā ca.
an6.42:3.4: Seyyathā pi bhante thullaphusitake deve vassante yathāninnaṃ udakāni pavattanti,
an6.42:3.5: evam eva kho bhante yena yen'eva dāni Bhagavā gamissati, tanninnā 'va bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā c'eva jānapadā ca.
an6.42:3.7: Tathā hi bhante Bhagavato sīlapaññāṇan' ti.
an6.42:4.1: ‘Māhaṃ Nāgita yasena samāgamaṃ mā ca mayā yaso.
an6.42:4.2: Yo kho Nāgita na-y-imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an6.42:4.3: so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyā' ti. 3.
an6.42:5.1: Idhāhaṃ Nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi gāmantavihāraṃ samāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ,
an6.42:5.3: ‘idān' imaṃ āyasmantaṃ ārāmiko vā ghaṭṭessati samaṇuddeso vā taṃ tamhā samādhimhā cāvessatī' ti.
an6.42:5.4: Tenāhaṃ Nāgita tassa bhikkhuno na attamano homi gāmantavihārena. 4.
an6.42:6.1: Idha panāhaṃ Nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi araññakaṃ araññe pacalāyamānaṃ nisinnaṃ,
an6.42:6.3: ‘idāni ayam āyasmā imaṃ niddākilamathaṃ paṭivinodetvā araññasaññaṃ yeva manasikarissati ekattan' ti.
an6.42:6.4: Tenāhaṃ Nāgita tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena. 5.
an6.42:7.1: Idha panāhaṃ Nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi araññakaṃ araññe asamāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ,
an6.42:7.3: ‘idāni ayam āyasmā asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samādahissati, samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ anurakkhissatī' ti.
an6.42:7.4: Tenāhaṃ Nāgita tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena. 6.
an6.42:8.1: Idha panāhaṃ Nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi araññakaṃ araññe samāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ,
an6.42:8.3: ‘idāni ayam āyasmā avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimocessati, vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ anurakkhissatī' ti.
an6.42:8.4: Tenāhaṃ Nāgita tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena. 7.
an6.42:9.1: Idha panāhaṃ Nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi gāmantavihāraṃ lābhiṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ,
an6.42:9.2: so taṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ nikāmayamāno riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, riñcati araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni,
an6.42:9.4: Tenāhaṃ Nāgita tassa bhikkhuno na attamano homi gāmantavihārena. 8.
an6.42:10.1: Idha panāhaṃ Nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi araññakaṃ lābhiṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ,
an6.42:10.2: so taṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ paṭipaṇāmetvā na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, na riñcati araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni.
an6.42:10.3: Tenāhaṃ Nāgita tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena.
an6.42:11.1: Yasmāhaṃ Nāgita samaye addhānamaggapaṭipanno na kiñci passāmi purato vā pacchato vā, phāsu me Nāgita tasmiṃ samaye hoti, antamaso uccārapassāvakammāyā ti.
